mostWorthwhile.text: Building the portal vessel made the two-capillary-bed route clear and showed why the liver encounters absorbed nutrients before the wider circulation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Slotting the portal vessel into the digestive tube was straightforward but added little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The connected liver has a separate arterial supply as well as portal input; the final picture also shows that not all nutrients leave the blood there.

arbitrary.text: I expected to join the digestive tube directly to hepatic venous return, but the body connection had to come first. The feedback made the required order clear, though its necessity was not initially obvious.

continue.text: I would continue: tracing the portal route and distinguishing its entry and exit made the system connections worthwhile, though the assembly order was occasionally less intuitive.
